note: How a value was found (performance value.method). standard_candidate names a published test method the lab may adopt; none is adopted yet. Our wording. Proposals awaiting review.

terms.label: light transmission
terms.definition: A light meter reads a set source with and without the fabric in between.

terms.label: weigh a cut area
terms.definition: Cut a known area from the conditioned fabric and weigh it.

terms.label: thickness gauge
terms.definition: Thickness between a flat foot and an anvil under a set pressure.

terms.label: counting glass
terms.definition: Count wales and courses over 1 cm of relaxed fabric with a counting glass.

terms.label: strip under fixed load
terms.definition: Hang a fixed load on a strip; read the extension, then the recovery after the load comes off.

terms.label: pneumatic bursting
terms.definition: Inflate a diaphragm under a clamped circle of fabric until it bursts.

terms.label: strip tensile test
terms.definition: Pull a 50 mm wide strip at constant speed until it breaks.

terms.label: air flow at set pressure
terms.definition: Measure the air speed through a set area at a set pressure difference.

terms.label: cantilever bending
terms.definition: Slide a strip over a horizontal edge until its tip drops to a set angle.

terms.label: Martindale abrasion
terms.definition: Rub the fabric against an abradant in a Lissajous path and count cycles to breakdown.

terms.label: model estimate
terms.definition: Worked out from the structure model and the machine settings, not measured.

terms.label: demo generator
terms.definition: Made up by scripts/taxonomy-demo.mjs. Not measured and not estimated.
